messages:
morgan: heads-up — demo next wk needs ~8 H100s in ap-southeast1 for a 3h slot. vendor says quota is delayed due to a billing hold. can infra confirm current quota and any quick workarounds?

kai: checking now — pulling project quotas and gpu inventory. give me 10m.

kai: quick console dump: `gcloud compute regions describe ap-southeast1` -> shows `acceleratorQuota: H100: 0/0` (no quota granted). also vendor portal shows 'pending payment' status.

morgan: ugh. demo is on Thursday. vendor ETA vague — said finance clearance in 48–72h. any temporary options (borrow, fallback)?

ana: @morgan tagging — if we can route the demo to eu-west1 we have H100 spare capacity for that window. latency to users is fine for demo. downside: region-specific dataset egress and compliance check.

anana: also quick thought: can we spin up ephemeral A100 rigs and use quantized model to mimic H100 perf? cheaper but not identical.

kai: short checklist I ran:
- open vendor ticket #VND-8421 (payment docs requested) — vendor says finance must approve.
- GCP quota request shows no active request in console.
- we have ~6 H100 available in eu-west1 (uncommitted).

kai: proposed steps:
1) @devon can we get terraform to add a temporary routing policy to prefer eu-west1 for demo requests?
2) open an infra ticket to start vendor payment escalation (finance copy).
3) if vendor clears in time, keep apac plan as primary; fallback to eu-west1 if not.

devon: I can add a quick flag in the routing service and config. small PR:
```hcl
resource "redwood_route" "demo_routing" {
  name = "demo-apac-fallback"
  primary_region = "ap-southeast1"
  fallback_regions = ["eu-west1"]
  window = "2026-03-26T08:00:00Z/2026-03-26T11:00:00Z"
}
```
I'll open the PR now. need a quick review & merge to flip the flag.

morgan: perfect. please add a note to README that eu-west fallback may need dataset copy. I can coordinate with product for demo content.

vendor-bot: Vendor portal update: Ticket VND-8421 status -> "Awaiting finance verification". Estimated clearance: 36-60 hours. Contact: ops@vendor.example.com.

morgan: that's within the 48–72h window but cutting it close. @oncall can you open an internal priority ticket to track?

oncall: opened INFRA-4792 (priority P1) — "APAC H100 vendor payment escalation". linked VND-8421 and created a finance @mention thread. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-4792 :heavy_check_mark:

kai: meanwhile I'll prepare a smaller perf profile for A100 fallback (reduced batch size + 8-bit quant). rough cmd I ran locally: `python bench.py --model redwood-open-alpha --quant 8 --batch 1 --tokens 512` — latencies look acceptable for demo runs.

devon: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing/pull/1382 — added the demo fallback route and a feature-flag. @kai can you run the smoke deploy in staging?

kai: starting staging deploy now. logs: 
```
deploy: routing-service:v1.42 -> staging
smoke: ok: route registered demo-apac-fallback -> eu-west1
smoke: integration test FAIL on dataset copy step (permissions)
```

morgan: dataset permissions — I can grant read-only copies from product for the demo scope. will do in 15m.

ana: FYI ops/legal said cross-region dataset copies for demo are allowed as long as we do not persist data in eu-west1 beyond the demo window.

kai: after prod perms update, smoke tests passed. staging looks green.

devon: I'm going to merge after one more +1. leaving a note: revert the route after Thursday if vendor clears.

morgan: thanks everyone. action items: INFRA-4792 tracking vendor payment, PR #1382 to be merged, product to grant dataset RO copy, demo to run in eu-west1 if apac quota not granted. I'll post final confirmation here tomorrow. :thumbsup: 

oncall: marking thread for follow-up. last update when vendor clears or after demo.

morgan: confirmed — demo switched to eu-west1 if we don't see quota by 2026-03-25 09:00UTC. closing for now but will reopen if anything changes.
